changelog:
Major update: Expanded Docker operations coverage and added detailed references.

- Added comprehensive references for container, image, registry, and system commands.
- Expanded supported commands to include image build/push/pull, Docker Compose, registry authentication, cleanup, and system inspection.
- Introduced advanced image operations such as image extraction and layer analysis.
- Clearly separated instructions for when to use or not use the skill.
- Organized all commands and guidance into modular reference markdowns for easy access.
